main.name: Hotelspecials
main.summary: Software engineer with more than five years of building cloud products, mobile apps and backends for clients like Germany's largest car manufacturer, and leading a team of six along the way. Now building Go microservices on AWS at Hotelspecials in Haarlem, with an app of my own, [Nook](/nook), on a side branch.

items: Backend Software Engineer at Hotelspecials, since June 2025.
Go microservices, and the AWS infrastructure they run on.
Moved to the Netherlands.
Back on a desk after a year without one.
Will bring up sourdough unprompted.
Off the clock: the garden, the kitchen, and any trail within reach.

main.name: Sabbatical
main.summary: A year away from the desk, on purpose, working seasonal jobs across four countries and coming back with skills no sprint teaches.

items: Removed the desk. Not backwards compatible with office hours.
Seasonal jobs in Italy, Iceland, Canada and the US.
A lot of trails.
The trip paid for itself, one seasonal job at a time.
Communication, adaptability and resilience, tested in new countries, new teams and new languages every few months.

main.name: freiheit.com
main.when: April 2020 to December 2023 · Full Stack Software Engineer
main.summary: Nearly four years at freiheit.com building four large-scale cloud products for some of Germany's biggest companies, and my first time leading a team.

items: A core mobile app for the next generation of electric vehicles from Germany's largest car manufacturer. Cross-platform, in Flutter.
A video on demand and networking app in Flutter, built for smooth performance and a polished UX.
A cloud-native online shop for Germany's third-largest fashion retailer: Vue.js in front, Go and Kotlin behind.
A contract management back office for the world's fourth-largest retailer.
Started leading: six engineers on the contract management back office, owning its architecture, scalability and performance.
Worked close to clients, turning their feedback into the product.
Picked up Kubernetes, MongoDB, MySQL and CI/CD pipelines along the way.
